notes: Searched JobsOhio, Team NEO, Crain's Cleveland and Akron press for a 2023 Akron hangar project and found no release naming this LLC; the name suggests a single-purpose aircraft-hangar real estate vehicle (possibly Akron Fulton or Akron-Canton airport), with no Form 5500 or JobsOhio metrics record. Developer and size unresolved; bucket is a best guess for a project LLC.

parent: Bitwise Industries (joint venture with ProMedica Health System)
notes: Landlord LLC for the Toledo Innovation Center, a 107,000 sq ft former post office rehab sponsored by Fresno-based Bitwise Industries with Toledo nonprofit ProMedica, financed with NMTC allocations plus JobsOhio grant and loan support. Bitwise had about 900 employees when it furloughed all staff in May 2023 and entered Chapter 7 in June 2023; which JV partner controlled the LLC is not stated in the sources found.

Bellisio Foods (formerly Luigino's, the EDGAR registrant) is headquartered in Minneapolis, MN and was acquired by Thailand's CP Foods for $1.08 billion in late 2016; CP Foods employs well over 100,000 worldwide. At the time of the 2015 grant, Bellisio was owned by private equity firm Centre Partners and would resolve to Bellisio itself (MN, 500-4999; Form 5500 showed 1,887 participants and JobsOhio lists 1,663 jobs retained at the Jackson, OH plant).

Independent 503B outsourcing pharmacy in Athens, OH; Form 5500 participant counts of 16 (2019) and 25 (2023) and JobsOhio's 17 jobs retained on a Workforce Grant all point to a company under 100 employees. No parent found.
Cleveland 501(c)(3) immigrant-attraction nonprofit with revenue of $1.0-1.9 million a year (2020-2024 Form 990s) and Form 5500 participants of 8 to 17. Not an operating business.

Canton, OH holding company for Superior Dairy (founded 1922 in Canton), Creative Edge Design Group and LEL Logistics; JobsOhio lists 298 jobs retained and Form 5500 shows 270 participants in 2019. Sold to Michigan Milk Producers Association (Novi, MI) effective Dec. 31, 2021, after the FY2020 grant.

Vadata, Inc. is the Amazon Web Services subsidiary that builds and owns Amazon's data centers, including its central Ohio campuses, and shares Amazon's Seattle address. Amazon reported about 1,298,000 employees at Dec. 31, 2020 in its FY2020 10-K.

Upstart Network is the operating subsidiary of Nasdaq-listed Upstart Holdings, headquartered in San Mateo, CA, with its second office in Columbus. The FY2021 10-K reported about 1,500 employees at Dec. 31, 2021, consistent with 2,060 Form 5500 participants in 2023.

parent: onMain Inc. (University of Dayton and Premier Health joint venture)
notes: Dayton 501(c)(3) formed in 2019 by the University of Dayton and Premier Health to redevelop the 38-acre former Montgomery County fairgrounds; Form 990 expenses were under $1 million a year through 2024, so its own staff is small. The two sponsoring institutions are large (Premier Health alone exceeds 5,000 employees), but the grant went to the redevelopment entity.

Project LLC for the office component of Gravity 2.0 in Franklinton, developed by Columbus-based Kaufman Development with a JobsOhio Spec Development (OSIP) grant; no Form 5500 plan. Kaufman is a small private developer that later sold Gravity 2.0 pieces; no employee figure published, so the bucket reflects a small real estate firm.

Independent craft distillery founded in Columbus in 2008 by Brady Konya and Ryan Lang, building a new 100,000+ sq ft distillery campus with JobsOhio Economic Development and Revitalization grants. JobsOhio lists 166 jobs retained but the 2023 Form 5500 shows only 32 plan participants, so headcount may be closer to 100 with many hospitality or part-time roles.

Nasdaq-listed truck maker headquartered in Bellevue, WA; FY2021 10-K reported about 28,800 employees worldwide, and Form 5500 shows 15,000-16,500 participants. Grants supported the Kenworth plant in Chillicothe (2,344 jobs retained).

Route 43 North LLC is the Geis Companies project vehicle for spec industrial buildings along State Route 43 in Streetsboro (Gateway Commerce Center), funded through JobsOhio's OSIP with Atlanta-based Stonemont as co-owner on part of the site. Geis, founded 1967 in Streetsboro and family-owned, says it has over 150 professional staff.

Canton light-pole maker (founded 1906) re-formed in May 2018 when New York industrial investment firm American Industrial Acquisition Corp (AIAC, 8,000+ employees across its portfolio) bought the bankrupt Union Metal Corp; treated as PE-style ownership so the operating company is the parent. AIAC planned about 250 Canton jobs by 2020 and the 2023 Form 5500 shows 135 participants.

Privately held conveyor and industrial oven manufacturer headquartered at 706 Lane Street, Sandusky, OH with three north central Ohio locations. JobsOhio lists 467 jobs retained and Form 5500 shows 186 (2019) to 369 (2023) participants, supporting 100-499; no parent found.

Family-owned greenhouse in Oberlin, OH operating for over 50 years with 150+ acres under glass; the company site cites over 800 employees and Form 5500 shows 880 participants in 2023, with JobsOhio listing 692 jobs retained. No outside parent.

County-created public port authority in Woodsfield, OH that received JobsOhio OSIP spec-development money for industrial sites in Monroe County; a small public body with no Form 5500 plan. Not an operating business.

Privately held material handling systems maker formed in 2018 in the Cincinnati area by former Intelligrated executives, headquartered in West Chester/Fairfield, OH with a plant in Guelph, Canada. The 2023 Form 5500 shows 415 participants and JobsOhio lists 220 jobs retained; no published headcount found.

Project LLC for the 100,000 sq ft OSIP-funded spec building on Bonnewitz Road in Van Wert announced in 2018 by Robinson Investments, a northwest Ohio developer with prior spec buildings in Findlay and Van Wert. The LLC-to-developer link is inferred from the project's timing and location; Robinson's own headcount is unpublished but it is a small private real estate firm.

NYSE-listed appliance maker headquartered in Benton Harbor, MI; the FY2020 10-K reported about 78,000 employees (about 97,000 in FY2015), and Form 5500 shows 28,000-31,000 participants. Grants supported the Findlay, Clyde, Marion and Ottawa plants (2,175 jobs retained).
